question: What is GPT-5, released by OpenAI in 2025, and what were its main new features?
text:
**GPT‑5 is a family of AI models that OpenAI released on August 7, 2025, in ChatGPT and through its API.** Its biggest change in ChatGPT was automatic switching: instead of making users choose between a fast model and a reasoning model, GPT‑5 could answer routine questions quickly and route harder problems to **GPT‑5 Thinking**. A **GPT‑5 Pro** option could spend more time reasoning on especially difficult tasks. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/?k=EAIaIQobChMIv-DY8f-b9QIVSOvjBx0PJAOcEAAYAiAAEgK71_D_BwE&utm_source=openai))

Its other main improvements were:

- **Better coding, reasoning, and tool use.** GPT‑5 was better at tasks such as debugging code, working through math problems, following detailed instructions, and using tools across multiple steps. OpenAI also reported improvements in writing and in interpreting images, charts, and diagrams. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/?k=EAIaIQobChMIv-DY8f-b9QIVSOvjBx0PJAOcEAAYAiAAEgK71_D_BwE&utm_source=openai))
- **More reliable answers.** In OpenAI’s evaluations, GPT‑5 made fewer factual errors and was less likely to agree with a user just to be agreeable. It could still make mistakes. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-system-card/?utm_source=openai))
- **More control for developers.** The API launched with GPT‑5, GPT‑5 mini, and GPT‑5 nano, a context window of up to 400,000 tokens, and controls for how much effort the model spent reasoning and how detailed its final answer was. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-for-developers/?utm_source=openai))
